tools.name: design_postcard
tools.description: Design a real printed postcard that IRLsend mails to someone in the US. Use it when the user wants to thank a client, customer or employee, follow up with a sales lead or prospect so they remember them, send a birthday, holiday, sympathy, get-well or just-because card, or reach someone by real mail

tools.name: revise_postcard
tools.description: Make a new version of a postcard designed with design_postcard: the same card code and link, changed as asked (for example a different color, drawing or wording). The new version replaces the current one on the card page. Only for a card that is not paid for yet. Do not include any street address, p

tools.name: check_postcard_order
tools.description: Check where a postcard made with design_postcard is: not ordered yet, waiting for payment, paid and going to print, mailed (with the expected delivery date when known), or refunded. Takes the card code.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: design_postcard · Public sink: design_postcard, revise_postcard.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: design_postcard · Public sink: design_postcard, revise_postcard

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
